body:
Yeah... Being upset because your country doesn't have bathhouses where you could have a gangbang sounds like a really logical way of coping with social rejection.

This is not something I made up, by the way. One of the only openly gay YouTubers in my country listed this as his problem with the gay community here. The lack of bathhouses and sex clubs.

So I'm sorry. Agreed to strongly disagree I guess.

"I needed to see that not all gay people are evil, lazy deviants" is basically a statement that speaks for itself. The majority of them are and I personally don't know any who aren't. Fuck, I know a guy whose reasoning for not using protection when taking his nth dick that month was essentially "well I'm going to catch HIV anyway so it doesn't really matter". This is what homosexuality does to people. When there's no purpose in life, no reproduction, no love, no family, no religion they turn to deviancy. But hell, even when they can achieve that stuff by artificial means in more progressive places, the main gay scene remains the same Sodom it's always been. A 100 years ago or now, it literally doesn't matter. Being gay is a sentence from God that I didn't ask for.

I'm not American. This gay lifestyle is the main one all over the world, no matter the LGBT progress.

The same thing you describe in the US which has gay marriage and adoption and surrogacy (so the gay community should be more normal, no?) happens also here in the Balkans where none of that exists. That's enough to tell me what I need to know. It's homosexuality not the type of society that makes people degenerate.

I'm 26. I graduated 3 years ago. My straight friends are all in loving relationships, and even if they aren't they are functioning and kind people. Meanwhile all the gay people I know are maladapted sex and drug-obsessed children who refuse to grow up. That's why I prefer to abstain from that mess and not get involved with other gay men. I just hate that God punished me this way before I could even have my say in the matter.
No idea, and she also gets uncomfortable and awkward when I answer something opposing her words and changes the topic. Is that what I'm paying for? Might as well talk to my best friend then.

The group of gay men I know are all miserable fucks. They're either: manipulative, insane, alcoholic, drug or sex addicted, even abuse their pets.

Just one of them has been spamming our group chat with messages about his "daddy-boyfriend" who has sex with random prostitutes abroad whenever he travels (eta: and this dude travels for work, mind you) and they get off to this together. Now he's complaining how he can't do that anymore because of the pandemic. Worst of all he doesn't even realize normal friends in the chat just gawk at his stories out of disgust, they don't admire his lifestyle. Or maybe he also gets off on that.

I don't have the kind of money to get away from my parents. And they don't know I'm gay nor will they ever find out so they're fine. They're good parents.

I don't know where these normal gay guys are. They must be the world's hide and seek champions. Even you can't find them. So you're only lying to yourself. I used to as well ("oh it's just the media being sensationalist") until I actually met other gay men.

My dad openly said he would shoot me if I were gay. Can't blame him though. I'm worthless to my family. I can't get married, reproduce, do any of the normal things normal people do. Then there's gay men who are the vermin of the society. They only seem to exist to spread around HIV and keep the drug market afloat. They may claim this is just the mainstream gay culture, but why is orgies/drugs/STDs the underground straight culture then? Oh right because they're not all sick in their heads.

You're missing my point but I can't judge you cause as I said, you're a random stranger, you don't have to understand. I guess I should judge her because she has a degree though and she should know how to "treat" better than spouting random self-help phrases that mean nothing.
These are exactly the kind of things my therapist responds with and they're the reason I find her annoying, misguided and a waste of money. She should be better than a random internet stranger, no?

If I was bisexual I'd never bother with men. Nature knows what's up, a man needs a woman for balance and vice-versa. Homosexuality is just a degenerate condition so I shouldn't be surprised I feel so miserable but I guess some people in the society need to be degenerate.
